skill.name: hubspot-email-backfill
skill.description: Find verified work emails for HubSpot contacts with missing or hard-bounced addresses. Review proposed updates before writing them, and keep a log of changes and unresolved records.
skill.summary: Backfill missing or hard-bounced HubSpot emails with Leadsets verification and a change log.
skill.author: leadsets

security_audit.summary: The shell, environment access, and reconnaissance alerts match Markdown formatting or normal CRM instructions, not the flagged behavior. The disclosed Leadsets connection receives contact data before the HubSpot write approval, which previews only the first ten changes. The change log includes personal data without specified access controls; no evidence of prompt injection or concealed exfiltration was found.

remediation.issue: Contact data can reach Leadsets before the user approves the transfer.
remediation.suggestion: Require approval before any enrichment or verification call. State the provider, fields, list, contact cap, and estimated usage. Send only the identifiers required for the match.

remediation.issue: The write preview shows only the first ten changes.
remediation.suggestion: Show the full proposed change set and total count. Bind approval to those records and recheck eligibility before each write.

remediation.issue: Change logs can expose personal data beyond HubSpot.
remediation.suggestion: Ask the user to approve a restricted destination before exporting. Minimize stored personal data and set a retention period.

content.user_title: Backfill Missing or Bounced HubSpot Emails
content.value_statement: Missing or hard-bounced email addresses leave HubSpot contact records incomplete. Find verified work addresses with Leadsets, approve proposed updates, and keep a record of changes.
actual_capabilities: Read a HubSpot list, view, or filter and remove duplicate contact IDs.
Check Leadsets usage and split larger runs into batches that fit available limits.
Test one contact first, then look up work emails using a LinkedIn URL or a name and company domain.
Reverify a returned address when it matches the address that previously bounced.
Preview the first ten changes and write only verified addresses to eligible HubSpot records after approval.
Return a change log and separate catch-all, unknown, and unmatched results from completed updates.
limitations: Requires a HubSpot connection and either the Leadsets MCP connection or a Leadsets REST API key.
Contacts without sufficient identifiers are skipped. Possible company changes are flagged for review.
The workflow checks enrichment results before the write preview, so withholding write approval does not prevent Leadsets usage or data transfer.
Does not send emails, enroll contacts in sequences, or update job titles or company fields.

use_cases.title: Fill blank email fields
use_cases.description: Find verified work addresses for contacts in a selected HubSpot view and review the proposed changes.

use_cases.title: Review hard-bounced contacts
use_cases.description: Check a recent bounce list for verified replacements and keep uncertain results separate for follow-up.

use_cases.title: Plan a larger cleanup
use_cases.description: Check remaining enrichment capacity and split a lead list into batches before authorizing changes.

prompt_templates.title: Try one contact
prompt_templates.prompt: Check one contact with a blank email from my HubSpot cleanup list. Tell me what Leadsets will receive and wait for approval before lookup. Report the result without changing HubSpot.
prompt_templates.scenario: Test the workflow on a single record.

prompt_templates.title: Preview missing email updates
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan a run for up to 25 blank email records in my HubSpot event list. Ask before contacting Leadsets. Show all verified proposals without writing any updates.
prompt_templates.scenario: Review a small set of candidate updates.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare verified bounce repairs
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the HubSpot hard bounce view and cap the run at 50 contacts. Ask before sending data to Leadsets. Recheck reused addresses and wait for approval before writing verified results.
prompt_templates.scenario: Process hard bounces without accepting unconfirmed addresses.

prompt_templates.title: Set limits for a staged backfill
prompt_templates.prompt: Check available Leadsets usage and plan batches of up to 100 contacts from the account review list. Ask before sharing identifiers. Show the full list of updates for approval before each batch. Flag company mismatches and use only the restricted log destination I approve.
prompt_templates.scenario: Manage a larger run with separate approvals for enrichment and updates.

output_examples.input: Review 20 blank email records in the event list without writing updates.
output_examples.output: 20 contacts reviewed. 12 verified addresses are ready for approval. Three catch-all results and two unknown results are held for review. Three contacts had no match. HubSpot was not changed.

output_examples.input: Apply the approved verified updates from the hard bounce list.
output_examples.output: Eight verified addresses were written to HubSpot. Two possible company changes were flagged and left untouched. The change log records the previous addresses.

best_practices: Choose a specific HubSpot list and confirm which fields may be shared with Leadsets before enrichment.
Review the full proposed change set before authorizing a bulk write.
Keep change logs in a restricted location with a retention period.
anti_patterns: Assuming that a write preview prevents Leadsets from receiving contact data.
Writing catch-all, unknown, or invalid addresses to the primary email field.
Exporting contact details to a shared sheet without checking who can view it.

faq.question: Which contacts does the skill process?
faq.answer: By default, it selects HubSpot contacts with blank email fields or hard bounces, up to 200 contacts per run. You can specify a list, view, filter, or smaller limit.

faq.question: What connections do I need?
faq.answer: Connect your agent to HubSpot. Use either the Leadsets MCP connection or a Leadsets REST API key.

faq.question: What contact data goes to Leadsets?
faq.answer: Enrichment uses a LinkedIn URL when available, or a name and company domain. Leadsets also receives a reused bounced email address when the skill rechecks it.

faq.question: Does the skill write changes automatically?
faq.answer: By default, it previews the first ten changes and asks for approval before writing. Only verified addresses qualify for the primary email field.

faq.question: How does the run use Leadsets records?
faq.answer: An enrichment that returns data uses one enrichment record. Standalone verification also counts, so the workflow checks available usage before batching.

faq.question: Does it send email or enroll contacts in sequences?
faq.answer: No. The skill updates eligible contact email fields and reports the results. It does not send messages or enroll contacts in sequences.
